note: Stub help texts for binarydata/help.edt, written for ja2-node. One row per record, keyed by the record names of the help text enum.

rows.HLP_TXT_CONSTANT_SUBTITLE: (stub help: press H to show it again)
rows.HLP_TXT_LAPTOP_OVERVIEW_P1: This stub page stands in for the laptop help. The laptop holds the mail, the web pages, the files, the history, the personnel records and the finances of the stub campaign.
rows.HLP_TXT_LAPTOP_OVERVIEW_P2: Close the laptop with its power button to go back to the map.
rows.HLP_TXT_LAPTOP_EMAIL_P1: Stub mail arrives here. Click a row to read it.
rows.HLP_TXT_LAPTOP_WEB_P1: The stub web pages are reached through the bookmarks.
rows.HLP_TXT_LAPTOP_FILES_P1: Stub files hold the intelligence gathered so far.
rows.HLP_TXT_LAPTOP_HISTORY_P1: The stub history lists what has happened in the campaign.
rows.HLP_TXT_LAPTOP_PERSONNEL_P1: The stub personnel page shows the hired team.
rows.HLP_TXT_FINANCES_P1: The stub ledger lists every payment and every income.
rows.HLP_TXT_FINANCES_P2: The balance is shown at the bottom of the screen.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P1: Stub stat one: health, the amount of damage a merc can take.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P2: Stub stat two: agility, how quickly a merc moves.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P3: Stub stat three: dexterity, how steady the hands are.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P4: Stub stat four: strength, how much can be carried.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P5: Stub stat five: leadership, how well others follow.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P6: Stub stat six: wisdom, how fast a merc learns.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P12: Stub paragraph twelve about the stats.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P13: Stub paragraph thirteen about the stats.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P14: Stub paragraph fourteen about the stats.
rows.HLP_TXT_MERC_STATS_P15: Stub paragraph fifteen, the last one.
rows.HLP_TXT_MPSCRN_NO_1_HIRED_YET_P1: Nobody is hired yet in this stub campaign.
rows.HLP_TXT_MPSCRN_NO_1_HIRED_YET_P2: Open the laptop to hire a team.
rows.HLP_TXT_MPSCRN_NOT_IN_ARULCO_P1: The stub team is on its way.
rows.HLP_TXT_MPSCRN_NOT_IN_ARULCO_P2: Compress time to let it arrive.
rows.HLP_TXT_MPSCRN_NOT_IN_ARULCO_P3: The landing sector is shown on the map.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_OVERVIEW_P1: This stub page stands in for the map screen help.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_OVERVIEW_P2: The team list is on the left, the map on the right.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_OVERVIEW_P3: The clock and the money are at the bottom.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_ASSNMNT_P1: Click the assignment column to give a merc a job.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_DSTINATION_P1: Click the destination column, then the sectors of the route.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_MAP_P1: The stub map shows sixteen by sixteen sectors.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_MILITIA_P1: Stub militia can be trained in liberated towns.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_AIRSPACE_P1: The stub airspace view shows where the helicopter may fly.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_ITEMS_P1: The stub sector inventory lists what lies in a sector.
rows.HLP_TXT_WELCOM_TO_ARULCO_KEYBOARD_P1: Stub keys: Space compresses time, L opens the laptop.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_OVERVIEW_P1: This stub page stands in for the tactical help. The tactical screen shows one sector of the stub world from above, with the team panel at the bottom. The mercs of the current squad have their faces in the panel.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_OVERVIEW_P2: Click a face to select a merc, then click a tile to walk there. A right click on the selected merc opens its inventory panel, where items are moved by dragging them from pocket to pocket.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_OVERVIEW_P3: Real time runs while no enemy is in sight. Once the stub enemy is seen, the game turns into turn-based combat, and every action costs action points shown in the panel.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_OVERVIEW_P4: Use the arrow keys or the edges of the screen to scroll, and the map button to leave for the map screen. This last stub paragraph is long on purpose, so that the page needs the scroll box.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_MOVEMENT_P1: Click a tile to walk, and hold the right button for the movement menu.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_SIGHT_P1: A stub merc sees what is in front of it.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_ATTACKING_P1: Point at an enemy and click to attack it.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_ITEMS_P1: Drag an item onto a pocket to move it.
rows.HLP_TXT_TACTICAL_KEYBOARD_P1: Stub keys: C crouches, S stands, P goes prone.
rows.HLP_TXT_SECTOR_INVTRY_OVERVIEW_P1: The stub sector inventory shows the items lying in the selected sector.
rows.HLP_TXT_SECTOR_INVTRY_OVERVIEW_P2: Drag an item onto a merc to pick it up.
